So for FGA with bromine addition, the typical reagent is NBS (N-bromosuccinimide), which appears as `O=C1CCC(=O)N1Br`.

from rdkit import Chem

# Product: COc1ccc(Br)c(CBr)c1
product = "COc1ccc(Br)c(CBr)c1"
mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(product)
print("Product SMILES:", product)
print("Product name:", Chem.MolToSmiles(mol))

    print(f"Atom {atom.GetIdx()}: {atom.GetSymbol()}, aromatic={atom.GetIsAromatic()}")

# Check neighbors
for bond in mol.GetBonds():
    print(f"Bond: {bond.GetBeginAtomIdx()}-{bond.GetEndAtomIdx()}, type={bond.GetBondType()}")

# Try to identify substituents

# Get substituents on ring
for idx in ring_atoms:
    atom = mol.GetAtomWithIdx(idx)
    neighbors = [n.GetIdx() for n in atom.GetNeighbors() if not n.GetIsAromatic()]
    if neighbors:
        for nidx in neighbors:
            neighbor = mol.GetAtomWithIdx(nidx)
            print(f"Substituent at position {idx}: {neighbor.GetSymbol()} (neighbors of substituent: {[nn.GetIdx() for nn in neighbor.GetNeighbors() if nn.GetIdx() != idx]})")
